summary: Phase-3 backend + frontend smoke testing. Backend: ALL 32 legacy pytest still pass + 17 new Phase-3 tests pass (49/49 = 100%). Verified: (a) /auth/login & /auth/register accept both legacy {mpin} and new {password}, (b) JWT exp ~365 days (well above 11-month threshold), (c) /auth/forgot-otp in demo mode returns {ok, otp_id, demo_otp} when sms_api_url is empty, (d) /auth/reset-password verifies OTP, resets pw, returns new token, and OTP cannot be reused, (e) POST /admin/upload + GET /api/files/{id} round-trip stores/returns data_url, (f) /wallet/upi-intent generates a upi://pay?pa=...&am=...&cu=INR URL with merchant info, (g) /settings exposes whatsapp_country_code, upi_payee_name, sms_api_url/key/method/sender/payload. Frontend smoke (real browser, prod URL): /login shows Mobile + Password + Eye toggle + Forgot link, no demo placeholders. /register has only 3 inputs (Name/Mobile/Password), no confirm field. /forgot-password loads. Dashboard: King Starline & King Jackpot tiles GONE; WhatsApp/Telegram/Deposit/Withdraw quick icons present. Quick-deposit navigates to /funds?tab=deposit. Funds Deposit shows all 7 qa-* chips (100/200/500/1000/10000/20000/50000); clicking 500 reveals all 5 UPI app intent links (upi-phonepe/gpay/paytm/bhim/any). /settings has 4 lang buttons (lang-en/hi/pa/ur); switching to Hindi inserts Devanagari chars into the page. /admin/settings has all required sections present visually: SMS/OTP Provider (SMS API URL, SMS API KEY, SMS Method, Sender ID, SMS Payload Template), WhatsApp country code, UPI Payee Name, Telegram URL, Withdrawal time window, Result API URL.

minor.issue: Accepts both {mpin} and {password} as designed; OK. Empty password returns 422 ('password is required') instead of 400 — minor, schema-driven.

ui_bugs.issue: All SMS provider inputs are missing the spec-mandated data-testid attributes: sms-url, sms-key, sms-method, sms-sender, sms-payload (count=0 each). The fields are functional but cannot be reliably targeted by automation.

Spec required FILE UPLOAD inputs with data-testid='poster-file-{i}' and image preview, but the rendered UI only shows URL TEXT inputs for image_url + link (no <input type='file'> visible, no poster-file-0/1/2 testid found). Base64 file-upload backend (/admin/upload + /api/files/{id}) IS working (verified by pytest), but the Admin UI does not appear to wire a file picker to it.

Only the 'Any UPI' link uses the upi:// scheme. The PhonePe/GPay/Paytm/BHIM hrefs use vendor deep-link schemes (phonepe://, tez://, paytmmp://, bhim://) — this is acceptable per spec (different UPI apps register distinct schemes) but worth confirming on a real Android device. All 5 anchors are present with correct data-testid values.

integration_issues.issue: Bar element with data-testid='sticky-place-bids' was not present in DOM during automation (count=0). Per spec this is conditional ('appears only when slip has items'), so the absence-when-empty is correct. We could not programmatically add a bid to the slip (the digit/amount/Add interactions did not register an item) to confirm visibility-when-items-exist. Manual verification recommended.

issues: The literal string 'MPIN'/'mpin' still appears somewhere in the HTML on /login and /register (likely a residual label or hidden helper text). The visible fields are correct (Mobile + Password) but legacy 'MPIN' text should be cleaned out to match the new password UX.

action_items: AdminSettings.jsx: Add data-testid attributes to SMS inputs (sms-url, sms-key, sms-method, sms-sender, sms-payload) so automation/QA can target them. Also recommended: wa-country, upi-payee, tg-url, wd-open, wd-close, result-api.

AdminSettings.jsx Home Posters: Wire FILE UPLOAD <input type='file' data-testid='poster-file-0/1/2'/> + image preview that converts to base64 and POSTs to /api/admin/upload (already working backend). Right now only URL text inputs are shown in production build, contradicting the Phase-3 spec.
Login.jsx/Register.jsx: Remove residual 'MPIN' literal strings from JSX (the visible inputs are correct but legacy MPIN text remains somewhere in DOM/source).

(Manual) Verify sticky-place-bids bar shows total + count when slip has items on /market/{id}/game/{key} — could not be reproduced programmatically; conditional rendering when slip is empty is correct.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py /auth/login: graceful auto-migration writes password_hash from mpin_hash on successful login — good. Consider also clearing mpin_hash once migrated to avoid stale legacy values.

server.py forgot-otp/reset-password: OTPs are bcrypt-hashed (good); however otp_id is returned in plaintext and a brute-forcer could try all 10^6 OTPs against a known otp_id (no attempt counter). Add a tries-counter and lock the OTP record after 5 wrong attempts.

server.py /admin/upload: cap at ~3MB is good, but no MIME-type sniffing — anyone with admin token can store any base64 blob in db.files (incl. JS). Validate that data_url starts with 'data:image/(png|jpe?g|webp);base64,' before storing.
JWT_TTL_HOURS = 24*365 effectively makes sessions never expire. Combined with no token-revocation mechanism, a stolen token is valid for a year. Acceptable for the UX requirement but worth noting.
Login.jsx/Register.jsx 'MPIN' literal in HTML (per smoke test) suggests dead UI strings — clean up to match the new password UX.
AdminSettings.jsx posters: file-upload functionality is the headline Phase-3 feature but appears not wired in the rendered UI. Re-deploy/rebuild?

rca_of_the_issue: Two clear gaps between spec and rendered UI: (a) admin SMS provider inputs lack data-testid attributes — likely just an oversight in AdminSettings.jsx field props, (b) poster FILE UPLOAD widget is missing from the rendered admin settings page even though the backend /admin/upload + /files/{id} endpoints are in place and pytest-verified — could be: AdminSettings.jsx wasn't rebuilt, the file-upload JSX block is conditionally hidden, or the new code path was committed but the legacy URL-input row is the only one shown. Recommend grep'ing AdminSettings.jsx for `type="file"` and `poster-file-` to confirm.
